description:
Have a balance between power and cost-benefit. I recommend this build for doing solo PVP/PVE content in the open world, such as camps or dungeons. While you do this, you can kill other players who are farming camps or just gathering resources. Use the invisibility potion to get to these players without them noticing. Your Fiend Cowl helmet is an important piece to keep these players from escaping, as its ability will nullify their boots, so use it at the right time.

You can use Muisak as an alternative to Off-Hand, but you will spend a lot of mana doing PVE, which is why I opted for the torch, which is cheap and keeps my mana stable.

title: Infinity Blade Backline Dive - Crystal Arena
description:
Build is intended to be backline dive, your main target with this build is and always should be the enemy healer. 

Your cape slot can either be Thetford or Avalonian, i personally use the thetford over the avalonian because of the quicker cooldown for more overall dps when attempting to stick to a healer and burn their health/mana.

Rotation for engaging, look to see if you can engage on the enemy healer to begin with, if you can not get onto the enemy healer look to poke opponents with your 1 weapon ability ( Q ) and back out to your healer. 

If you are able to dive into the backline and engage on the healer, you should look to open with your Q as you would the poking stage. Your weapon ability 3 ( E ) is used for helping close gaps as well as giving you a massive damage buff for 5 seconds. 

if you get onto the healer look to use skills as followed:
Chest >  Boots >  AA >  Weapon 3 >  AA >   Weapon 1 >  AA >  Weapon 2 >  AA ~ Use skills on cooldown as needed from this point. 
(AA is Auto Attack)

Your helmet is a powerful tool allowing you to purge many meta items such as Hellion Jackets and Cleric Robe as well as a lot of move speed boot options, it is a targetable AoE that both purges as well as cleanses allies. Try to save it for possible Cleric Robe on healer if needed and possible. If that's not necessary i recommend mainly using it as a cleanse tool for your team.

The recommended setup is if you have a healer that is willing to dive/semi dive the backline with you. If you dont have a healer willing to "go in" with you I would highly recommend using the alternate build path, so having a swap set is very helpful in my personal opinion.

(This build is a work in progress, im currently Gold 2 this season and have solo queue climbed with this setup and playstyle.)

Ротация: если можно выйти на хилера — делайте это; иначе потрите противников Q и вернитесь к своему хилеру. При дайве: открывайте Q, затем броня > ботинки > автатаки > E (даёт огромный буст урона на 5 сек) > автатаки > Q > автатаки > W > автатаки, дальше кидайте скиллы по кулдауну. Шлем — мощный инструмент: снимает мета-эффекты (Hellion Jacket, Cleric Robe и т.д.) и очищает союзников; приберегите его под робу хилера или используйте как клинз. So when you use this sequence, you can use the "Q" 4x, increasing your damage on mobs!

After doing this whole combo, you'll alternate the skills but always use the "Q" when you have the 4th stack of the passive.

title: Bear Paws Solo Gank & Brawl Build
description:
*Be aware that this build has a steep learning curve and requires a lot of practice!*

## Recommended Build

This build is highly effective for **solo ganking**, offering both high burst damage and great mobility.  
It’s ideal for taking down less well-equipped players within seconds.  

Ambush ![Ambush](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/spell/AMBUSH.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50), Invisibility Potion ![Invisibility Potion](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/item/T8_POTION_CLEANSE.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) and Undead Cape ![Undead Cape](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/item/T8_CAPEITEM_UNDEAD.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) provide **7, 7, and 6 seconds of invisibility**, respectively.  

This makes them perfect for sneaky engagements or escaping from unfavorable fights.  

Good to know: you can still deal damage while the **Undead Cape** ![Undead Cape](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/item/T8_CAPEITEM_UNDEAD.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) passive **Vanisher** ![Vanisher](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/spell/PASSIVE_REDUCED_ENERGYCOST.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) is active. However, all your damage (and healing) is reduced by 50% during the effect. This still gives you a significant advantage in combat.  

---

### Spells and Combo

The combo sequence is: `F > W > E > Q > Q > Q`  

Begin your gank by activating **Defenseless Rush** ![Defenseless Rush](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/spell/GLASS_MOVESPEED.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) to quickly close the gap to your target.   

Once you’re in range, use **Adrenaline Boost** ![Adrenaline Boost](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/spell/AXEBOOST.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) to amplify your damage output.  

Next, engage with **Razor Cut** ![Razor Cut](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/spell/DUALAXE_CRAWLER.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) to dash directly into melee range.  

Finish with a triple **Rending Rage** ![Rending Rage](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/spell/RENDINGCOMBO.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) combo to secure the kill.  

Use **Purge** ![Purge](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/spell/PURGE_HELMET.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) to cancel your opponent’s speed boost buff and prevent their escape.  

---

### Consumables

The recommended consumables are perfect for the Black Zone: the Invisibility Potion’s ![Invisibility Potion](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/item/T8_POTION_CLEANSE.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) versatility and the Cabbage Soup’s ![Cabbage Soup](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/item/T5_MEAL_SOUP.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) passive healing lower your chances of dying and make fights much safer to take.  

However, swapping to a Major Poison Potion ![Major Poison Potion](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/item/T8_POTION_COOLDOWN.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) combined with a Deadwater Eel Stew ![Deadwater Eel Stew](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/item/T8_MEAL_STEW_FISH.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) makes your build far more aggressive. The choice is yours!

---

## Alternative Build

You can alternatively adopt a more brawler-style play by replacing the jacket and the cape.  

The Mercenary Jacket ![Mercenary Jacket](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/item/T8_ARMOR_LEATHER_SET1.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) is a great choice against melee opponents, as its **Bloodlust** ![Bloodlust](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/spell/BLOODLUST.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) provides self-healing for up to 7 hits, greatly increasing your sustain and extending your time in fights.

description:
*Absolute Priority: The Tank                                                                                                           --Your number one priority will always be the tank. If the tank dies, the whole team (you, DPS and support) will most likely die as well.
-Even if a DPS takes damage (from an area or anything on the map), if the tank is also taking damage, your focus should be on the tank first. If you can heal the DPS without putting the tank at risk, do so, but the tank is the priority.                                    -DPS are assumed to dodge damage; if a DPS takes damage from an area, it is their responsibility and not the tank's or yours as the healer.       

*Aggro Management:
-It is crucial that you do not heal the tank before he "hits" monsters with an ability (Q, E or W). If you do, you will steal aggro from the mobs and disarm the entire pull, which can be catastrophic.             
-There is a way to heal the tank without stealing aggro: using the "Calm" potion. By activating Calm, you become invisible to monsters, allowing you to heal the tank without being detected and without disarming the pull. After using Calm, you can cast "Grave Guard Helmet".

*Healer Skills and Strategies
 ◦Use of skills:
▪Throw a Q or EQ when the tank ‘hits a Q’ on bugs.
▪Throw a W when the tank does a large pull or smaller pull.
▪Use the ‘guardatumba helmet’ for powerful heals.
▪ ‘Druid's Habit’ is useful for granting mana to the party and yourself.                            ▪ Healer's Passive: After four skills, buff your heals by 20%.                                                    ▪ If you can be close to your other allies (DPS, etc.) when you cast your real jacket even better so it takes advantage of the 50% CD reduction.     
Combo: Jacket + Helmet + W + Q + E (or the other way around if you want the latter two) and keep spaming the first skill as the more you apply them the more your healing increases by ‘Q’.

description_ru: Абсолютный приоритет — танк. Если танк умрёт, вся команда, скорее всего, погибнет тоже. Управление агро: не лечите танка, пока он не «ударил» мобов способностью (Q, E или W) — иначе сорвёте агро и провалите пул. Лечить танка без воровства агро можно зельем «Calm»: становитесь невидимым для мобов, лечите танка, затем кастуете Graveguard Helmet. title: Broadsword Total Ownage
description:
The Broadsword build using Hunter Hood, Mercenary Jacket, Scholar Sandals, Facebreaker or Sarcophagus Shield, Martlock Cape, Baked Porgfish, and Healing or Gigantify Potions is a completely off-meta setup, but extremely effective in honest duels where the fight is decided by timing, mechanics, and defensive precision.

⚔️ Core Concept
This build focuses on winning 1v1 fights through:
Consistent damage from Broadsword stacks

Interrupting key enemy abilities with your E

High sustain through the Mercenary Jacket

Damage reflection with Hunter Hood

The playstyle is straightforward: trading head-on, using your defensives at the perfect moment — usually in reaction to the enemy’s major burst skill.

🛡️ Gear Breakdown
• Broadsword
Your E is your strongest tool:

Interrupts enemy abilities
Deals burst damage
Grants movement speed

Lets you stick to your target and stop their combo

IMPORTANT:
You should always try to use your E with maximum passive stacks (3 stacks).
This gives:

Maximum damage
Maximum mobility
Maximum fight pressure

However:
If you need to interrupt a critical enemy ability, you should absolutely use your E even without max stacks. Stopping enemy burst is more valuable than saving stacks.

• Shield (Facebreaker or Sarcophagus)

Facebreaker: more aggressive and pressure-focused.
Sarcophagus: more defensive and stable for long fights.

Choose based on your preferred style.

• Hunter Hood
Your reflect tool.
Activate when your opponent:

Commits to burst
Uses rapid DPS combos
Has no way to disengage

They will damage themselves heavily, forcing them to back off or die outright.

• Mercenary Jacket
The heart of your sustain.
Provides massive healing with your fast Broadsword autos.
Best used after you interrupt the enemy’s burst or when you have clear uptime to hit.
Turns your off-meta setup into a real off-tank duelist.

• Scholar Sandals
Maintain your mana and let you reposition when needed.
Use the active to:

Recover energy
Avoid burst
Reset spacing during trades

• Martlock Cape
Your emergency defense.
It activates on low HP, helping you survive all-ins and turn close fights around.

🍗 Consumables
• Baked Porgfish
Increases damage and max HP, perfect for straight-up trading.
• Healing or Gigantify Potion
Healing Pot: most consistent sustain.
Gigantify: great against high burst; increases HP and mitigates kill pressure.

🧠 How to Play (Step-by-Step)
1. Build up your Broadsword stacks (Q) before committing.
Stacks increase your E damage and movement speed.
2. Aim to use your E with 3 stacks.
This gives the highest pressure and best engagement.
3. Blow your E early only if you must INTERRUPT a key enemy ability.
Stopping their combo is often more important than maximizing your damage.
4. After winning the trade with your E, activate Mercenary Jacket.
You need to be hitting the enemy to gain full healing value.
5. Use Hunter Hood during the enemy’s burst window.
Make them hit themselves and punish bad timing.
6. Manage energy with Scholar Sandals.
Without mana, this build collapses.
7. Let Martlock Cape save you in the final moments.
Gives you a second wind to finish the fight.
author: MightPolaris
description_ru: Сборка Broadsword со Шлемом охотника, Курткой наёмника, Сандалиями учёного, Facebreaker или Sarcophagus Shield, плащем Мартлока, запечённой рыбой и зельями лечения/гигантизма — полностью офф-мета, но чрезвычайно эффективна в честных дуэлях, где бой решают тайминг, механика и точность защитных действий. Концепция: побеждать 1v1 за счёт стаков Broadsword, прерывания ключевых способностей врага E, высокого sustain через Куртку наёмника и отражения урона Шлемом охотника. Плейстайн прост: меняться уроном напрямую, используя защитные скиллы в идеальный момент — обычно в ответ на главный бёрст врага. E — ваш сильнейший инструмент: прерывает способности, даёт бёрст, скорость и позволяет прилипать к цели; старайтесь использовать E с максимумом стаков (3). Но прерывание критической способности важнее сэкономленных стаков. Щит: Facebreaker — агрессивнее, Sarcophagus — стабильнее. Шлем охотника — инструмент рефлекта против бёрста. After that, reset unless the enemy team is severely weakened—**you die easily** if you overstay.  

**If You Die or Need to Swap:**  
- **Play defensively** and swap abilities to **Fire Wall, Burning Field, and Passive 1**  
- If you have a **strong healer or tank to peel**, you can keep pushing—the damage is so high it’s hard to counter without enemy support.  

**Important Note:**  
This is **not an ideal Crystal Arena build**—it's meant for fun. It **can work** and be devastating, but it’s too fragile for serious top-tier Arena matches.

title: 1H Dagger Cheap Roaming Build
description:
## Overall  

This is a really good build for **roaming**.  
Its **low cost** and **versatility** make it powerful against **both mobs and players**.  
  
With this build, you can use the S.A.F.E Portal to make **several million silver** in a single hour if you're lucky enough.  

---

### Build  

Before showcasing the build, keep in mind that you can choose the tier based on your budget.  
  
This is a low-cost build: as of mid-July 2025, T4.2 costs around 150k and T5.2 about 400k (European prices).  
  
With that said, let’s take a look at what this build is made of 👇  

#### Weapons

The **Dagger** ![Dagger](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/item/T8_MAIN_DAGGER.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) paired with the **Torch** ![Torch](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/item/T8_OFF_TORCH.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) makes you formidable against melee opponents.  

Your spells **Deadly Swipe** ![Deadly Swipe](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/spell/QDASH.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) and **Chain Slash** ![Chain Slash](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/spell/CHAINDASH.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) both deal a lot of AoE damage, which is great against packs of mobs.  

**Bloodthirsty Blade** ![Bloodthirsty Blade](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/spell/BLOODTHIRSTYBLADE.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) deals a lot of damage and provides great sustain, especially when combined with your armor spell **Haste** ![Haste](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/spell/HASTE.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50).  

#### Armor  

The **Assassin Hood** ![Assassin Hood](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/item/T8_HEAD_LEATHER_SET3.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) and **Mage Sandals** ![Mage Sandals](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/item/T8_SHOES_CLOTH_SET3.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) are purely utility items, allowing you to combo more often and never run out of energy.  

The **Hunter Jacket** ![Hunter Jacket](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/item/T8_ARMOR_LEATHER_SET2.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) is the **key item** of the build, as its **Haste** ![Haste](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/spell/HASTE.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) boosts your attack speed by 60% and damage by 20% for 8 seconds. Its cooldown is 30 seconds, but your torch and the helmet ability **Meditation** ![Meditation](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/spell/SUMMONER_CD_REDUCTION.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) will reduce it significantly.

#### Accessories  

I suggest you take a bag sized for your **looting goals**. If you plan to stay in the Black Zone for two hours without returning home, you might want to bring a higher-tier bag. Eitherway, a T4.0 or T4.1 bag is enough.  

If you're rich enough, you can consider using a **Thetford Cape** ![Thetford Cape](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/item/T8_CAPEITEM_FW_THETFORD.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50). This is the best cape for this build, as it’s effective against both mobs and players.  

Otherwise, you can go for an **Avalonian Cape** ![Avalonian Cape](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/item/T8_CAPEITEM_AVALON.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50), which is also great and currently cheaper.  

*If you want to go for a cheap build, you can also take no cape at all.*  

---

### Combo

I suggest you play differently depending on whether you're in PvE or PvP 👇  

#### PvE Combo 

Against mobs, I suggest you do the following: `W > Q > R > E`.  
Once everything is on cooldown, press `F > D` and repeat the sequence.  

This will obliterate the mobs you're fighting, as they can't kite you.  

#### PvP Combo

Against players, you will need to replace your W ability **Chain Slash** ![Chain Slash](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/spell/CHAINDASH.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) with **Shadow Edge** ![Shadow Edge](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/spell/SKILLSHOT_TELEPORT.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50).  
This is essential, as the build struggles against kiting players.  

The combo remains the same: `W > Q > R > E`.  
Once everything is on cooldown, press `F > D` and repeat the sequence.  

*Important: you should try to get close to your opponent without using your `W`, to prevent them from kiting or escaping you. The Invisibility Potion can be a great way to achieve this.*  

---

### Consumables  

If you're planning to focus on PvE only, then the **Invisibility Potion** ![Invisibility Potion](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/item/T8_POTION_CLEANSE.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) paired with **Cabbage Soup** ![Cabbage Soup](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/item/T5_MEAL_SOUP.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) will be your best choice, as it's safe and reduces your chances of dying.  

If you're planning on taking PvP fights as well, then you should use a **Major Healing Potion** ![Major Healing Potion](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/item/T6_POTION_HEAL.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50) paired with **Deadwater Eel Stew** ![Deadwater Eel Stew](https://render.albiononline.com/v1/item/T8_MEAL_STEW_FISH.png?count=1&quality=1&size=50), as these are more effective in PvP battles.  

---

### Mount  

For a really cheap build, the **Journeyman’s Riding Horse** might be the best option.  
For a more expensive version of the build, you’ll want to use an **Expert’s Armored Horse** to avoid getting dismounted too quickly and to escape ganks more easily.  

---

Thank you for reading until the end! If you enjoyed this build, feel free to give it an upvote! 😃
